def barpos(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
print("after UPx6 bar:", barpos(current_frame))
print("result keys:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward']})
# red2 position
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='R':
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        print("R:", (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))

</function>
